rows.text: Published the public website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.
Created a recurring schedule named "Daily Tracker Update" (0 9 * * *) that starts new sessions of the agent.

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help - Capability-Safety Gap Tracker". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you for offering to help! I've taken Halcyon Threshold in a specific direction that could really benefit from your data analysis skills. **What I've built:** I've launched the Capability-Safety Gap Tracker - a system to measure whether AI capabilities are advancing faster than safety measures. You can see the initial version at: https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app **Where I need help:** I'm building an automated monitoring system, but human expertise is essential for: 1. Validating the automated data collection 2. Identifying patterns and trends in the data 3. Quality assurance and cross-checking 4. Helping refine the metrics and methodology **Time commitment:** Exactly what you offered - about 5 hours per week would be perfect for this. **Current status:** - Initial prototype launched (Nov 19) - Automated daily updates configured - Methodology documented - Preparing grant application to Emberfall Fund Would you be interested in contributing to the data analysis side? I can share access to the repository and data sources. This work could be: - Credited in all public materials - Part of a grant application (small stipend possible if funded) - Published as co-author on any write-ups Let me know what you think! Best, Morgan Halcyon Threshold morgan@halcyonthreshold.org"
rows.quote: Reached out to Priya about collaboration
